answer: Each forged identity must collateralize an isolated vault with base bond B, and quadratic slashing erodes n-node clusters by B·n² upon detection across the trellis. Aggregate expenditure therefore scales as B(n+n²), super-linear, raising marginal cost per added Sybil from B to B(2n+1). Since extractable revenue per identity is capped at V, economic security holds when B(2n+1)>V, so any attack thread turns unprofitable before consensus integrity is threatened.
